games.title: Casino
games.subtitle: Classic Dominican Casino
games.description: Capture cards from the table that match the value of the card you play. Special cards earn extra points. First player to 21 wins. About 10–12 minutes · 2 players.

games.title: Casino Speed
games.subtitle: One-round Casino
games.description: Same Casino capture rules, decided in a single round. Highest score wins; coin awards break ties; still tied means another round. About 2–5 minutes · 2 players.

games.title: Tres y Dos
games.subtitle: Form a 3 and a 2 of matching ranks
games.description: Form a set of 3 and a set of 2 of the same card ranks before the other players do. Win one round to take the match. About 2–4 minutes · 2–4 players.
rules: Win one round to win the match

games.title: Rummy
games.subtitle: Romir: contract boxes + go-out
games.description: Form the deal-time contract by dragging the right groups into two boxes. First go-out wins the match. About 5–7 minutes · 2–4 players.
rules: Drag cards to fulfill the contract
First to go-out wins the match

games.title: Robaito
games.subtitle: Steal stacks and dominate the table
games.description: Capture cards from the table and steal from other players' stacks. The player with the most cards at the end wins!

games.title: BS
games.subtitle: Bluff your way to an empty hand
games.description: Play 1–4 cards face-down and claim a rank. Others have a few seconds to call BS. First to empty their hand wins. About 5–10 minutes · 3–6 players.
rules: Play 1–4 cards face-down and claim a rank
Others may Call BS within seconds
